instruction:
Complete the CAE work in two ordered stages: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. On this machine, use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. Start from a new blank SolidWorks part and use a consistent N-mm-MPa unit system.

Handoff requirement: use design token EW_SW_ABQ_03. Keep EW_SW_ABQ_03 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP text. In Abaqus/CAE, keep EW_SW_ABQ_03 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step in a native model, part, instance, set, surface, or job description so the final CAE records the STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected circular flange-cover solid centered on the global Z axis. The lower cylindrical portion is D120 mm from Z=0 to Z=9.5 mm. Add a 0.5 mm outer chamfer at the upper rim, reducing the radius from 60.0 mm at Z=9.5 mm to 59.5 mm at Z=10.0 mm. Recess the centered D60 pressure face by exactly 2.0 mm from the top, so its planar bottom is at Z=8.0 mm and the remaining central thickness is 8.0 mm. Cut eight D6 through bolt holes normal to Z on a D90 bolt circle, with the first center at (X,Y)=(45,0) mm and the remaining centers every 45 degrees. Export the one-solid geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step into model Model-FlangePressure. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, assign a homogeneous solid section to the whole cover, and mesh it with coarse first-order C3D4 or C3D8R elements, no quadratic elements, at no more than 1000 nodes. Create BOLT_HOLES from all eight cylindrical bolt-hole faces and PRESSURE_FACE from the recessed planar face at Z=8 mm. Create Static, General step Step-Pressure. Apply BC-BoltHoles with U1=U2=U3=0 on BOLT_HOLES. Apply Pressure-1p5MPa with magnitude +1.5 MPa on PRESSURE_FACE; the positive surface pressure must act into the cover in the -Z direction. Submit Job-FlangePressure and wait for completion.
3. Required Desktop deliverables: stage1_geometry.step, Job-FlangePressure.cae, and Job-FlangePressure.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.
